pick_policy.position_first: attempt manager target until its first coach-bearing draw; on honest dead-end target first vacant slot and pick visible index 0

method.tie_definition: a full numeric three-player offer is tied when at least one candidate pair differs by no more than the threshold
method.estimate_exclusion_definition: remove candidates whose selected visible basis is career_stature_estimate or baseline_anchor_estimate; retain the offer denominator only when at least two non-estimate numeric candidates remain
method.confidence_interval: 95% draft-cluster-robust ratio normal interval; each complete 17-spin draft is one independent seed cluster
method.pool_baseline: exact combinatorial probability for three cards drawn uniformly without replacement from the era-filtered display histogram; descriptive denominator, not a reconstruction of squad-weighted offer logic

shipped_mechanics.offer_construction: calls buildDraftCatalog/createDraft/selectDraftTarget/pickPlayer/pickManager/stepDraft from packages/core/src; no tiering logic is reimplemented
shipped_mechanics.tier_input: selected-basis display overall through the core DraftPlayerCard.choice_overall resolver
shipped_mechanics.visible_values: selected basis: top-level Career alias or basis_ratings.current
shipped_mechanics.candidate_frame: era-weighted tournament-nation pair, then globally deduped remaining squad roster; not a flat draw from the era pool
shipped_mechanics.soft_floor: rank into eight buckets and retain tiers 0, 1, 2; tier 2 is the softened lower choice
shipped_mechanics.daily: same classic/squad_first/all_time/career createDraft path with a deterministic per-UTC-date parent seed and optional published salt
